what: Always use `aide-memory` (or `aide`) command in docs, demos, and prompts — not `node /path/to/dist/cli/aide-memory.js`. Run `npm link` in the project root first to make the command available globally. Use realistic test projects with real files, imports, and dependencies for demos and validation — not empty temp directories.
